narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, in month {first_bar_apart_month}, the ghost holding slightly more to fall back on. The layoff came in month {layoff_month}, and the ghost met it with {layoff_net_worth_gap}. Your days and the ghost's ended {life_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
